description: The file defines a React functional component 'FiltersSidebar' for rendering a sidebar UI that allows users to filter recipes based on several criteria such as cuisine, category, maximum preparation time, and tags. It manages synchronization with URL search parameters for filtering state, providing apply and reset controls.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Constructs URL search parameters based on current filter states and updates the browser route to apply the filters.

methods.name: toggleTag
methods.description: Toggles the presence of a tag in the selected tags list.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets filters by navigating to the homepage.
